results.title: Packaging Paper Finger Flick.wav
results.author: afleetingspeck
results.description: The sound of a flick of a finger hit hard on a piece of packaging paper. A very percussive hit. Sounds like a pistol gun shot. Recorded using the sampler in Redrum in Propellerhead Reason 5. Equalizing used to get rid of noise and harsh frequencies and maximizer used to make sound audible. Recorded on 3 Jan 2012.
